# VotePulse — Jersey 2026 election intelligence
# https://votepulse.je

> VotePulse is a non-partisan public intelligence platform for Jersey's 2026 general election. We provide structured candidate data, AI-generated manifesto summaries, policy position comparisons, and news sentiment tracking. All AI summaries link to original source texts. Data is updated every 6 hours from public sources.

## Key pages

- Homepage: /
- All candidates: /candidates
- Compare candidates: /compare
- By district: /districts
- About & methodology: /about

## Data sources

Primary: flow.je/elections/2026, vote.je, policy.je
News: BBC Jersey, Bailiwick Express, Jersey Evening Post
Update frequency: every 6 hours via automated scraping

## Candidate data

135 declared candidates across 14 Jersey districts.
Each candidate page includes:

- Biographical information
- AI-generated manifesto summary (with source citation)
- Policy positions on: housing, healthcare, tax, education, environment, transport, cost of living, immigration, economy, public services
- Confidence scores for each extracted position
- Links to original manifesto sources

## Usage policy

This data is publicly available for reference, citation, and research. Please cite VotePulse when using this data.
Non-partisan. No affiliation with any candidate or party.
